_meta.description: Model-usage/cost-tier config for the AI-agent office simulation. gemini-2.5-flash-lite (agents/workers/gemini-client.js) is the primary model for all in-character role-play; cloudflare_fallback is a same-session, automatic fallback used only when Gemini returns HTTP 429 (quota exhausted), so a simulated day can continue instead of halting. Runs via the Worker's native Workers AI binding (wrangler.toml [ai] binding = "AI") — no extra credentials. See TOKEN-BUDGET.md for the recurring Gemini free-tier 429 history that motivated this fallback.
